تمتزجي (form VIII)
# تَمْتَزِجِي (tamtazijī) /tam.ta.zi.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# تُمْتَزَجِي (tumtazajī) /tum.ta.za.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
